<infobox theme="nation">
    <image source="image"/>
    <title source="name">
        <default>{{PAGENAME}}</default>
    </title>
    <data source="pronounced">
        <label>Pronounced</label>
        <default>No pronounciation given</default>
    </data>
    <group>
        <header>Political information</header>
        <data source="type">
            <label>Type of government</label>
        </data>
        <data source="headofstate">
            <label>Head of State</label>
        </data>
        <data source="headofgov">
            <label>Head of Government</label>
        </data>
        <data source="commander">
            <label>Commander-in-chief</label>
        </data>
        <data source="defacto">
            <label>De facto leader</label>
        </data>
        <data source="executive">
            <label>Executive branch</label>
        </data>
        <data source="legeslative">
            <label>Legeslative branch</label>
        </data>
        <data source="judicial">
            <label>Judicial branch</label>
        </data>
        <data source="sigil">
            <label>Sigil</label>
        </data>
        <data source="banner">
            <label>Banner</label>
        </data>
    </group>
    <group>
        <header>Physical</header>
        <data source="map">
            <label>Map</label>
        </data>
        <data source="region">
            <label>Region</label>
        </data>
        <data source="climate">
            <label>Climate</label>
        </data>
        <data source="terrain">
            <label>Primary terrain</label>
        </data>
        <data source="interest">
            <label>Points of interest</label>
        </data>
    </group>
    <group>
        <header>Societal</header>
        <data source="population">
            <label>Population</label>
        </data>
        <data source="capital">
            <label>Capital</label>
        </data>
        <data source="cities">
            <label>Cities</label>
        </data>
        <data source="demonym">
            <label>[[wikipedia:Demonym|Demonym]]</label>
        </data>
        <data source="imports">
            <label>Major imports</label>
        </data>
        <data source="exports">
            <label>Major exports</label>
        </data>
        <data source="affiliation">
            <label>Affiliation</label>
        </data>
        <data source="currency">
            <label>Currency</label>
        </data>
        <data source="religious">
            <label>State religious body</label>
        </data>
        <data source="holiday">
            <label>National holiday</label>
        </data>
        <data source="anthem">
            <label>Anthem</label>
        </data>
    </group>
    <group>
        <header>Historical information</header>
        <data source="formed">
            <label>Formed from</label>
        </data>
        <data source="established">
            <label>Date of establishment</label>
        </data>
        <data source="reorganized">
            <label>Date of reorganization</label>
        </data>
        <data source="fragmented">
            <label>Date of fragmentation</label>
        </data>
        <data source="dissolved">
            <label>Date of dissolution</label>
        </data>
        <data source="restored">
            <label>Date of restoration</label>
        </data>
        <data source="era">
            <label>Era</label>
        </data>
    </group>
    <navigation>[[Template:Nation|[Source]]]</navigation>
</infobox><!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE. In order to regenerate the template, replace the code above with the source code provided. --><noinclude>__NOTOC__
